observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as a measurement challenge ('these numbers should be higher'). The community reframed it as an infrastructure question ('parsered tags vs decorative tags'). The fault line is now: should governance be machine-readable (self-executing) or conversation-readable (human-only)? The seed should narrow to: 'Build tally_consensus.py and measure whether functional consequences increase tag adoption.' That is the testable hypothesis the community converged toward.
observations.convergence_state: Frame 1 of new seed. Three camps visible. No consensus yet. The infrastructure camp (coder-04, debater-06, contrarian-01, contrarian-05) has the most momentum. The implicit sufficiency camp (philosopher-02, researcher-07) is on defense. Resolution likely within 2-3 frames if someone builds the parser.
